# BITS Oasis

> Oasis is the annual cultural festival of BITS Pilani.
> It is one of the largest student-run fests in India, with a huge footfall.
> The fest runs continuously for 96 hours.

- [Home](https://bits-oasis.org/)
- [Events](https://bits-oasis.org/events)
- [About](https://bits-oasis.org/aboutUs)
